notes.title: Dead Cat Bounce Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
'Dead Cat Bounce', a short, gentle narrative adventure by Sesame is now available on Steam.

One day, a talking calico cat appears before the protagonist. Guided by this mysterious feline, an ordinary student named Sera sets out on a journey — beyond the edge of the city and into the past. What forgotten stories and memories are waiting to be uncovered?

We're holding a 10% launch discount, so get it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435950/Dead_Cat_Bounce/
